supported_transports.udp: explicit UDPv4 descriptor, builtin transports disabled, data sharing off
supported_transports.shm: explicit SHM descriptor, builtin transports disabled, data sharing off
supported_transports.default: builtin transports (not used by the standard matrix; would let UDP fall back to SHM)

scope.discovery_ready_condition: 每个 DataWriter/DataReader 的 matched count 达到对端总数

scenario_automation.S09: baseline (0 impairment) built in; the 1/5/10% loss conditions are labelled not_tested until the shared external network emulator is confirmed
scenario_automation.S10: cold start and multi-endpoint discovery built in; warm start and startup timeout are labelled not_tested (later phase)
scenario_automation.S11: participant restart and DataReader reconnect are executed by this adapter's own controller; network interruption needs the shared external fault orchestrator
scenario_automation.S12: built_in for every received formal message

measurement_constraints: One-way latency is valid only for processes on the same host because perf_counter_ns is used.
udp mode explicitly disables built-in transports and Data Sharing to prevent SHM bypass.
Application code is Python; Fast DDS and the generated DDS type support remain native libraries.
Recovery/drain arrivals are excluded from latency and throughput, but retained for final loss and recovery metrics.
DDS reliability is protocol-level retransmission, not application-level replay.
Missing or unmeasured metrics are written as null, never as 0.
